name: 32374-varloadeagle-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1). Weights are 17.7 GB of an 80 GB card.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB. Drafter: a one-layer EAGLE head at the target's width, ~0.78B params, 1.55 GB fp16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=22.0 requests/s, bounded at 3600 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 15% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), single turn, from `configs/data/mtbench-80-turn1-llama31.jsonl`: the 80 first-turn MT-Bench questions, prompt tokens mean 66.7, min 13, max 350. Output is fixed at 512 tokens for every request (guidellm sets max_tokens=512 and ignore_eos=True) and decoding is greedy.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, giving 512-token answers at 22 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit 78e7293bb157498d23780891cc4ef365a31772b6. Interpreter, wheel and hardware are
# per-machine and live in configs/env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

# 2048 is the draft head's own max_position_embeddings; it is the largest value the pair agrees on.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Off deliberately: the engine's default at this commit is ON.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Written out so the head, whose config.json says float16, is loaded at the target's dtype too.
dtype: bfloat16
